answer: Audit the TIMING of actions, not their content: record each identity's activity as a time-series and flag sets whose series move in lockstep, same reaction latency to shared events, same inter-action rhythm. One controller driving a farm runs its heads off a single scheduler, so they spike together, a cross-correlation that betrays one hand however the wording is varied. Honest agents act on their own clocks and scatter, each a separate island; no quill-stroke of synchrony links them. The bridge the farm cannot hide is simultaneity: a thousand heads pulsing as one is the tell.
